enunciado: Create BankAccount with a private balance. deposit(amount) only accepts positive amounts and withdraw(amount) only if there is enough balance; both return bool. Run a sequence of operations and show the result of each and the final balance.
objetivos: Validate inside methods to keep the object consistent
Expose reading through a getter method
pistas: From main you cannot write account.balance = -100: the attribute is private.
Each method decides whether the operation is valid.
Returning a bool lets the caller know whether it worked.
